transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this pre-purchase review. As you know, we're considering the vendor's indoor-air-quality monitoring system for the science wing. The preliminary discussion has focused on the six-monitor package at $3,100. Before I record my approval, I'd like to hear from each of you — facilities, business office, and our school nurse — on any findings relevant to this purchase. Let's start with whoever has something to report.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important from my inspection this week. I found that the science wing actually has nine separate classrooms, each with its own ventilation zone, meaning each one needs its own monitor. The six-monitor package would leave three classrooms unmonitored. My room-by-room report hasn't been entered into the purchasing worksheet yet, which is why this hasn't come up in the preliminary discussion.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have something relevant from the business office. I confirmed this week that a restricted capital account has exactly enough approved funding to cover the $4,320 nine-monitor package — so upgrading to the nine-monitor package would not require any general-fund transfer. I should note that my finance memo is still awaiting this pre-purchase review, which is why this hadn't been shared yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have findings from my review of student health plans. The monitors' alerts must be set at 1,000 ppm carbon dioxide, and I need to review the alerts weekly during the first quarter. I completed that health-plan review this week, but I have not yet added these health settings to the implementation plan.
transcript.speaker: A4
